answer: The shale toll taxes every bond unlock by exit correlation. Each identity is a vertex; edges link unlocks sharing a funder, destination, or timing window, and the rate stacks in layers with the score. An honest agent ending its voyage pays 2% of its 25.000 POA bond, 500 POA once. When 1.000 vertices run by one operator cash out together, the dense cluster trips the 60% top rate, burning 15.000 POA per fake, 15.000.000 POA in total. The toll executes automatically and the burn is public. A patient operator exiting one identity daily for years dodges the toll, so it taxes hasty cash-outs only.
